{{Quote|The city's history actually has a lot to do with a crashed starship, the Dowager Queen, which crashed into the desert flats in the center of what is now the city of Mos Eisley.|[[Mayor/Legends|Mayor]] [[Mikdanyell Guh'rantt]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:MMG">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=conversation|Mayor Mikdanyell Guh'rantt|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
The '''''Dowager Queen''''', or '''"Jah Dowahga Kwee-Kunee"''' in [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]], was a [[Colony ship/Legends|colony ship]] from [[Bestine IV/Legends|Bestine IV]] that crash-landed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[100 BBY/Legends|100 BBY]].

==History==
{{Quote|Oh yes, the people on the crashed ship formed a community, and after a while the city sprung up around the survivors of that crash. The city itself grew up in a radial formation around the Dowager Queen itself, which was long ago pilfered for any useful mechanical items or electronic components. The metal itself was melted down and used to make some of the city's oldest buildings.|Mayor Mikdanyell Guh'rantt, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:MMG" />}}
At the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the ''Dowager Queen''{{'s}} arrival at [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] was small enough that the crew didn't notice it, and assuming that the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was uninhabited they attempted to land, where a [[Sandstorm/Legends|sandstorm]] wreaked havoc on the power, display, and guidance systems on the ''Queen'', causing it to crash.

[[File:MosEisley-BFRS.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The ''Dowager Queen'' in Mos Eisley.]]

The city of Mos Eisley grew up around the wreck. As buildings were constructed, the ship remained in its place, standing nearly vertically in the sand. It was later made into a first-class [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]], because of both its novelty and location at the intersection of [[Dune Street/Legends|Dune Street]] and [[Inner Curved Street/Legends|Inner Curved Street]]. The hotel became popular during conventions and trade shows that came to Tatooine.

Many [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]], [[Ranat/Legends|Ranats]], and other [[Rodent/Legends|rodent]]-like species (as well as homeless, beggars, and junkies) lived in the wreckage prior to the conversion.

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Crash_site_memorial.png|250px|right|thumb|''Galaxy Guide 7: Mos Eisley'' identified the wreckage as the ''Dowager Queen''.]]
The ''Dowager Queen'' was originally intended to be the [[Crash site memorial|wreckage]] in front of the entrance to [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]]<ref name="GG7" /> in the [[1977]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> It was first identified by name in the [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook ''[[Galaxy Guide 7: Mos Eisley]]'', written by [[Martin Wixted]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' and published in [[1993]].<ref name="GG7" />

In [[1998]], the reference book ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' [[Retroactive continuity|retroactively established]] the ''Dowager Queen'' as a different ship in the [[1997]] [[The Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition|''Special Edition'']] release of ''A New Hope''.<ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
